connector.name: PromptOT
connector.registryDescription: Manage, version, and publish LLM prompts with blocks, variables, and evaluations.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.promptot.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.promptot, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PROMPTOT_API_KEY
env.description: Scoped API key from the PromptOT dashboard (Settings > API Keys)

env.name: PROMPTOT_MCP_CLIENT
env.description: Client identifier for analytics attribution (e.g. claude-desktop, cursor)
